profile_text.body:
Snap Inc describes itself as a company built around the camera, saying it believes the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. It says it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The site text repeats the camera statement twice.

The company is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, trading under the ticker SNAP, with SEC CIK 0001564408. No specific products or MCP servers are listed for it, and no individually named lawsuits appear. Its recorded legal exposure in California stands at 281.
